data.name: Hirday
data.gender_notes: Hirday is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hirday in Sanskrit represents the deepest part of an individual's being, encompassing both heart and mind. This name invokes a sense of wisdom, understanding, and inner strength. The name Hirday carries the meaning “Heart, Mind” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hirday usually hope their child will grow to embody heart, mind and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hirday total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
